newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr was quoted marginally weaker compared to the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.6210 against the dollar compared to 6.6040 last week.
The bank said that following a currency auction on May 10, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the May 12 to 18 period would be 6.6210 birr to the dollar.
The bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 10.7644 against the pound from 10.7328 last week, while against the yen, the birr traded at 0.054306 from 0.053378 last week.
